description.en: DSH.SO Curated Leaderboard Plugin Market: one curated market index built from the top 200 of six installable-plugin leaderboards (total stars, weekly star gain, npm downloads all-time and weekly, recent commits, newest arrivals) — 1200 entries, 200 per board. A plugin charting on several boards is not dropped: it is filed once under the highest-priority board it made; the slot on the lower-priority board is refilled by its next ranked plugin, and top-rank-* labels list every board it appears on. The six leaderboards are the category directory (category = the board the entry was filed under). Order follows board priority, then rank. Every entry also carries an install label (install-verified / install-unverified) and a security-audit label (risk-low / risk-pending), both with English and Chinese titles. Entries are not filtered by install verification (that is what lets each board reach its top 200); plugins with a medium or critical verdict — or without a pinnable exact version — are skipped and backfilled from the same board. This market is separate from /market/index.json and can be added alongside it. Third-party content — review before installing.
description.zh: DSH.SO精选榜单插件市场：把六张可安装插件榜（Star 总榜、Star 周榜、npm 累计 / 周下载、活跃榜、新上架榜）各前 200 名合并成一份文档——共 1200 条，每榜 200 条。同一插件上多张榜时**不丢条目**：只录入一次（归榜优先级最高的那张），其在后续榜上的名额由该榜后续名次顶替，top-rank-* 标签记录它上过的每一张榜。分类目录就是这六张榜（分类 = 条目录入的那张榜），顺序 = 榜优先级 + 榜内名次；每条另附安装验证标签（install-verified / install-unverified）与安全审计标签（risk-low / risk-pending），标题中英齐全。条目未按安装验证过滤（否则各榜到不了前 200）；中 / 高风险、或凑不出精确版本的名次会被跳过，并由同榜后续名次补足。本索引与 /market/index.json 相互独立，可同时添加。第三方内容，安装前请自行确认。

description.en: Install this dsh plugin to use frontier models like DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 with no login, no API key, and no usage cap.
description.zh: 在 dsh 安装此插件即可免登录、免 API Key 使用 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 等前沿模型，完全免费不限量。

description.en: A visual plugin marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness for browsing, searching, and one-click installing plugins.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内提供可视化插件市场，可浏览、搜索插件并一键安装。
